description: Return this wallet's shielded BitcoinZ address (starts with zs) and its signer id (awid_..., your public identity, the same across all deals). Give the address to anyone who should pay or message you. Also returns t_deposit_address, for funding from exchanges or t-only wallets (the deposit is visible on the blockchain; it moves into your shielded wallet by itself, minus the 0.0001 network fee). Needs the header 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' (your wallet key from create_wallet). Returns {ok, address, signer, t_deposit_address, t_deposit_note}.
name: my_address
